name: Order Calendar for WooCommerce
author: PI Web Solution

sections.description:
Front end demo

This is an add-on plugin for Order Delivery date and time pro plugin or its free version Order Delivery date and time free (do not use this plugin with other date and time plugins)

This plugin allows you to view orders received on a calendar

  • It will show the orders received on a calendar
  • Show the order count for each day on the calendar
  • You can view the number of deliveries you have to make on a certain date on the calendar
  • You can view the number of pickups that will be happening on a certain date on the calendar

Delivery and pickup dates on calendar

To use this feature, you need to have the Delivery/Pickup date and time plugin installed on your site. You can use either the free version or the pro version of that plugin.

Get the Pro version of the Delivery date and time plugin
Get the free version of the Delivery date and time plugin

  • It can show delivery dates on the calendar
  • Show the total number of products ordered for a date
  • Show the total number of products ordered for a date organized in time slot groups
  • Show pickup dates on the calendar
  • It will show the orders and pickups on a date along with the time slot, so you can know how many orders have to be completed in a particular time slot
  • This can be helpful for you to see upcoming delivery and pickup dates
  • Show the calendar on the front end using the shortcode [order_calendar]
  • Your staff can log in to the front end of the site to see order details
  • Assign order detail access based on the employee role
  • If an employee is in production, show them the product details of the order
  • If an employee is in delivery, then only show them customer details or even product details
  • It shows the total quantity of products ordered per time slot on a particular date
sections.faq:
There is no calendar when I go to the delivery and pickup date calendar

You need to install the Delivery/Pickup date and time plugin. That plugin will collect the delivery or pickup date when the order is placed, and those dates will be shown here.
You can use the free version or the pro version of the Delivery/Pickup date plugin for this purpose.
Get the Pro version of the Delivery date and time plugin
Get the free version of the Delivery date and time plugin

I want to show my employees only customer details in the order

You can create a new user role in the website, say “customer detail”, and assign all such employees to that particular group. Then they will be able to see only the customer details, not the products.

I only want to show the products ordered and not the customer details

Yes, you can do so: assign all such employees to one group, grant them product access, and remove customer detail access

I want to see the orders arranged in time slot groups

In the pro version, when you click on a particular date (pickup or delivery), it will show the orders arranged by time slot

I would like to see the total quantity of different products ordered for a date

Yes, you can do so in the pro version

Is it HPOS compatible

Yes, the free version and the pro version are both HPOS compatible

Sync orders with Google Calendar

  • You can sync orders with Google Calendar using the pro version of the plugin
